events.verdict: Horford (BOS) slightly extends his arms against Durant's (GSW) front during the screen but he is able to move through contact.
Durant (GSW) makes contact to the arm of Tatum (BOS) on the drive that affects his SQBR.
Green (GSW) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Morris (BOS) and firms up on his shoulder during the pick but he is able to move through contact.
Morris (BOS) briefly grasps Green's (GSW) jersey during the pick but it does not affect his FOM.
Irving (BOS) makes marginal contact to the body of Durant (GSW) during his shooting motion that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Tatum (BOS) takes 2 legal steps after he gather the ball on his dribble.
Green (GSW) moves laterally into the path of Tatum (BOS) during the drive but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Green (GSW) firms up on Smart's (BOS) shoulder and makes marginal contact during the pick.
Smart (BOS) makes contact to the arm of Thompson (GSW) during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Curry (GSW) makes marginal contact with Irving's (BOS) arm during the pick.
Smart (BOS) establishes himself in a screening position in Thompson's (GSW) path and does not deliver contact.
